statements.impact_statement: This finding affects Docker daemon archive-upload handlers, not the client libraries in oc/kubectl. The Containerfile fails if docker/daemon or cmd/dockerd enters the oc dependency graph. The runtime contains only clients, no Docker daemon or server-side PUT /containers/{id}/archive handler.

This finding affects Docker daemon bind-mount setup during docker cp. The Containerfile fails if docker/daemon or cmd/dockerd enters the oc dependency graph. The runtime contains only oc/kubectl clients and does not mount containers or run the vulnerable Docker daemon.

The affected Distribution pull-through cache proxy is server-side code. The Containerfile fails if registry/proxy, registry/handlers, the registry/storage package itself, or registry/storage/cache/redis enters the oc dependency graph. The client imports only the independent cache interface and memory cache, not a pull-through registry proxy.

The affected code is the registry server storage/deletion path with Redis blobdescriptor caching. The Containerfile fails if the registry/storage package itself, registry/handlers, registry/proxy, or registry/storage/cache/redis enters the oc dependency graph. Independent client-side cache/memory helpers are allowed; no registry server, Redis blobdescriptor cache, or storage deletion handler is linked.
